display_name: Superior Attuned Superior Absolute Resolution A
help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Enhances the damage of a power by {Boost.Attrib.Damage.Scale}% and accuracy by {Boost.Attrib.Accuracy.Scale}%.  This enhancement can only be slotted by Guardians and may be slotted into any of their damage powers.
